project: Wuxia Life P97 Merchant Magnate Native Entry Differentiation
description: Wire P95/P96 ledger/caravan operating personality into magnate_on_ramp for native merchant_house path with bounded entry expression and continuity into P55 magnate skeleton. No full magnate rewrite, no merchant_martial_patron bridge, no P63/P64 regression.

userStories.title: Audit native merchant magnate entry flattening
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the native merchant_house magnate entry gap documented so P97 targets the P95/P96 to magnate discontinuity instead of reopening P55.
acceptanceCriteria: Document current magnate_on_ramp gates, flags, and expression for native vs bridge-origin paths
Explicitly identify where P95/P96 ledger/caravan flags are not read at magnate entry
Distinguish P63 bridge differentiation from native track differentiation
Save one bounded report under docs/test-reports/
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Read-only gap inventory. Maps GAP-P96-D01/D02/D03 to implementation scope.

userStories.title: Wire P95/P96 continuity into magnate on-ramp
userStories.description: As a player, I want my ledger or caravan operating personality to carry into the magnate threshold so midlife identity does not reset at age 28.
acceptanceCriteria: magnate_on_ramp or equivalent narrow wiring reads at least one P95/P96 track or expansion flag for native merchant_house path
Ledger and caravan produce different player-facing text, condition branch, or downstream marker
Change affects at least one downstream state beyond flavor-only text
P55 magnate chain on-ramp to pressure to payoff remains reachable
P63/P64 bridge-origin paths do not regress
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Core continuity story. Native ledger = steady scale-up framing; caravan = market-driven threshold.

userStories.title: Strengthen native magnate entry expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want magnate entry cost labels and goals to reflect whether I am a steady ledger scaler or a market-driven caravan operator.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or refine at least two player-facing expressions for native ledger vs caravan at magnate entry
At least one expression reads P95/P96 operating or expansion flags
Bridge-origin P63 expressions retain priority when bridge markers are set
Identity text uses player-facing merchant terms rather than raw state-key names
No new dedicated UI panel is required
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Expression layer at magnate_on_ramp. P63 bridge branches take precedence over native track branches.

userStories.title: Preserve magnate chain continuity
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want native entry differentiation to feed P55 pressure/payoff without orphaning the magnate spine.
acceptanceCriteria: magnate_midlife_pressure remains reachable after native differentiated on-ramp
At least one upstream read path connects P96 age-40 identity flags to magnate entry or first pressure checkpoint
Seed 804 replay baseline does not regress
No replacement of existing magnate spine event IDs
npm run typecheck passes
Relevant merchant-focused tests pass
userStories.notes: Continuity-wiring story. Prefer markers and conditions over parallel dead-end branches.

userStories.title: Add narrow proof and regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want proof and tests for native merchant magnate entry differentiation so the stage closes on evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least one focused test covering ledger and caravan native paths into magnate on-ramp
Produce or update one proof artifact under docs/test-reports/
Proof shows age, P95/P96 flags, magnate entry marker, and at least one changed player-facing outcome
Verification does not require full-lifetime broad audits
npm run typecheck passes
Relevant merchant-focused tests pass
userStories.notes: Evidence-first closeout. Guard P55/P63/P64/P96 baselines alongside new native entry chain.

userStories.title: Produce stage closure and next-step boundary
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating what P97 proves and what remains deferred.
acceptanceCriteria: Save a closure report under docs/test-reports/
State what was added at magnate native entry
State what remains deferred (magnate pressure/payoff native differentiation, martial patron, full empire)
Explicitly say this stage does not implement merchant_martial_patron or full magnate rewrite
Name the next bounded candidate stage after this one
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Close with explicit defer boundaries toward native magnate mid/late differentiation or martial patron bridge.
